properties.displayName: UAV S51 - Container Service Forced Kill (Slowloris-induced)
properties.description: UAVResourceMetrics_CL에서 핵심 컨테이너(telemetry-tap/mavlink-router/pgse-stub/auth-stub) CPU 고갈(slowloris형 리소스 고갈) 직후 UAVServiceAudit_CL에서 파괴적 강제 stop/kill이 발생하는 패턴 탐지. 탐지맹점 생성 및 C2 두절 위험. MITRE: T0881,T1529
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 20m;
let criticalContainers = dynamic(["telemetry-tap","mavlink-router","pgse-stub","auth-stub"]);
let cpuGate = 90.0;
let CpuSpike =
    UAVResourceMetrics_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where ContainerName in (criticalContainers)
    | where CpuUsagePct > cpuGate
    | summarize MaxCpu = max(CpuUsagePct) by ContainerName, TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m);
UAVServiceAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where ContainerName in (criticalContainers)
| where Action in ("stop", "kill")
| where IsDestructiveAction == true
| extend TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| join kind=inner (CpuSpike) on ContainerName, TimeBin
| extend TriggerReason = strcat(ContainerName, "_slowloris_CPU고갈후_강제중단_", Action)
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, ContainerName, ActorId, ImageName, Action, ExitCode, Signal, MaxCpu, IsDestructiveAction, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S51 - Container Service Forced Kill (Slowloris-induced) - {{ContainerName}}
